T: Put on a show. Put on the kettle.
D: Walter, Gary and Mary get the Muppets back together to save their old theatre from an oil baron.
P: Serve the snacks when the telethon finally goes live.

Popcorn, pretzels and cheese crackers in big bowls, refilled for the volunteers manning the phones.
the Swedish Chef in the kitchen
Pork and beef meatballs with onion and allspice, browned and simmered in a creamy gravy, served with lingonberry jam on toothpicks.
Gary and Walter's home town of Smalltown
Thick fries cooked twice until crisp, salted and served in paper cones with tomato sauce.

Miss Piggy working at the fashion magazine in Paris
Steak frites of sirloin seared and rested, with thin fries and a béarnaise of yolks, butter and tarragon. Not pork.

s.note: the Swedish Chef in the kitchen
s.how: Mix 250g pork mince and 250g beef mince with a grated onion and a pinch of allspice. Roll into small balls and brown. Add 200ml cream and a splash of water and simmer 10 minutes. Serve on toothpicks with lingonberry jam. Bork bork.

s.note: Gary and Walter's home town of Smalltown
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thick fries, rinse and dry. Fry at 140C until soft, then fry again at 190C until crisp. Toss with sea salt and pile into paper cones with tomato sauce on the side. Smalltown, USA approved.

m.note: Miss Piggy working at the fashion magazine in Paris
m.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thin fries and fry twice until crisp. Sear 4 sirloin steaks and rest. Reduce white wine vinegar with tarragon, whisk in 2 yolks over gentle heat, then slowly add 150g melted butter. Serve the steak over the fries. Not pork.

w.how: Crush 250g sweet biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a tin. Beat 300g icing sugar with a little butter, peppermint essence and green colouring and spread over. Pour melted dark chocolate on top, chill and cut into squares.

d.how: Fill tall glasses with ice. Pour in cranberry juice first, then slowly add pineapple juice and orange juice over the back of a spoon so they layer. Top with lemonade. A rainbow in a glass for the show.
